title: Oven Roasted British Sweet Potato Scotch Egg
description: A twist on the classic Scotch egg, this dish features sweet potatoes and is perfect for a lazy Sunday, it is also Whole30-friendly and made with beurre-monte for a rich flavor.

ingredients.name: sweet potatoes
ingredients.notes: peeled and chopped into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Spread the sweet potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, boil the eggs in a large pot of water for 10 minutes, then immediately transfer them to a bowl of ice water to stop the cooking process.
Once the eggs have cooled, peel them and set them aside.
In a small saucepan, melt the beurre-monte over low heat.
To assemble the Scotch eggs, wrap each egg in a layer of roasted sweet potatoes, securing them with a toothpick if necessary.
Drizzle the melted beurre-monte over the top of each Scotch egg.
Serve the Scotch eggs hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
